# Arcline FFmpeg 9.1 configure profile (spec docs/specs/ffmpeg-9.1-upgrade.md §5.3).
#
# One argument per line; blank lines and #-comments are ignored by build.sh.
# Decisions: D1 = LGPL v2.1+ (no --enable-version3), D2 = no Media Foundation (no h264_mf),
# D3 = in-repo source build, D4 = P0 fixes landed first.
--target-os=mingw32
--arch=x86_64
# Host note (recorded in manifest.json): this is a native MSYS2 UCRT64 build, not a cross build.
# The UCRT64 toolchain installs prefixed GCC but only unprefixed binutils (nm/ar/ld), so the
# spec's --cross-prefix=x86_64-w64-mingw32- is omitted; the compiler is the native UCRT one and
# the output is still x86_64-w64-mingw32/UCRT. See docs/specs/ffmpeg-9.1-upgrade.md §5.2.
--enable-shared
--disable-static
--disable-debug
--disable-doc
--disable-ffplay
--disable-gpl
--disable-nonfree
--disable-autodetect
--enable-w32threads
--enable-zlib
--enable-d3d11va
--enable-d3d12va
--enable-dxva2
--enable-ffnvcodec
--enable-nvenc
--enable-amf
--enable-libvpl
--enable-libdav1d
--enable-libsvtav1
# Local files only: 9.1 adds libcurl and a Windows handle: protocol; none may exist (S1/S2/S3).
--disable-network
--disable-protocols
--enable-protocol=file,pipe
--disable-demuxer=hls,dash,concat,sdp,rtsp,rtp
--disable-muxer=tee,segment,hls,dash
--disable-indevs
--enable-indev=lavfi
--disable-outdevs
# S7: mingw-w64 GCC 16.2 links libssp, so strong stack protection is available.
--extra-cflags=-fstack-protector-strong
--extra-ldflags=-fstack-protector-strong
